# GDRFA - Email & Notification Translation Sheet (English to Arabic)

**Purpose:** All user-facing **emails**, **in-app notifications**, and **push notifications** generated by the GDRFA Sports & Recreation backend are currently written in **English only**. This sheet lists every unique English string.

**How to use (for the client):**
1. Fill the **Arabic Translation** column for every row.
2. Do **NOT** translate the placeholder tokens in `{curly braces}` — they are replaced at runtime with real data (event name, date, employee name, etc.).
3. Keep emojis (📅 ✅ ❌ 👤 📋 👑 🏃 🌟 ✓ 🎯) where they appear.
4. Return the completed file; the developer will integrate the Arabic into the system.

---

## Placeholder Legend (do not translate — keep as-is in Arabic text)

| Token | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `{User}` / `{Manager}` / `{Admin}` / `{Employee}` | Recipient's name |
| `{Event}` / `{Event Name}` | Event name (will be inserted automatically) |
| `{Activity}` | Activity name |
| `{Team}` | Team name |
| `{Facility}` | Facility name |
| `{Name}` | Requester / user name |
| `{email}` | Email address |
| `{Location}` | Event location |
| `{startDate}` / `{endDate}` / `{Start} - {End}` | Dates |
| `{startTime}` / `{endTime}` | Times |
| `{Status}` | Approval / rejection status text |
| `{Reason}` / `{comment}` | Rejection reason |
| `{Level}` | Approval level number |
| `{url}` | Clickable link |
| `GDRFA` | Keep as "GDRFA" (brand name) |

- **Orphan email templates** exist in `Node/views/emails/` but are **NOT wired** to any `sendEmail` call (dead/legacy): `team-player-assignment.ejs`, `regular-event-assignment.ejs`, `employee-add-to-manager.ejs`, `email-set-password-template.ejs`, `coordinator-template.ejs`, `admin-facility-request-notification.ejs`. If translated, they would need wiring; consider removing or wiring separately.
- **Dead code:** `Node/legacy emailTemplates/resetPasswordTemplate.js` references a non-existent `reset-password.html`.
- **Dead notification:** `commonController.js:888-898` has a commented-out `Facility Request Status Changed` in-app notification.
- **Existing Arabic:** Some in-app notifications already store both `title_ar`/`message_ar` (D-table entries). The D-row Arabic columns above should be filled with the client's Arabic to replace/verify the hardcoded Arabic already present.
